notes: OU Price does not publish a full-time MBA class profile (no GMAT, GRE, GPA, work experience, or demographic figures) or an employment rate on any official page found via site search. Tuition is published only as a total for the 16-month program; no annual rate exists, so the value carries an explicit note rather than an annualized guess. The full-time MBA page gives the program's location as Oklahoma City, OK, and says the full-time program offers its required courses during the day on the OKC campus, so the city is Oklahoma City rather than the university's Norman campus (read 2026-09-27, https://www.ou.edu/price/mba/full-time).
